description: This file defines interfaces for a GStreamer-based media player, including a factory class for creating player instances and the main player interface with methods for media control, source management, and configuration.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IGstGenericPlayer.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayer
classes.description: Interface for a GStreamer-based media player with methods for media control and source management.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton factory instance.

methods.name: createGstGenericPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new IGstGenericPlayer instance with specified client, decryption service, media type, video requirements, and utils wrapper factory.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the player.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source of specified type from the player.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Notifies that all sources have been attached.

methods.name: setVideoGeometry
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the video display rectangle.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Queues an end-of-stream notification for a media source type.

methods.name: attachSamples
methods.description: Attaches new media samples for playback.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets or seeks to a specific playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Requests rendering of a pre-rolled frame.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Sets the mute state of the audio pipeline.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves the mute state of the audio pipeline.
